Our mission is to empower independent supply stores with best-in-class technology. Think of your local hardware store or mom-and-pop nursery—these are our clients. We’re aiming to help them modernize so that they can continue to thrive.

Backed by leading investors including Battery, Bessemer and CRV, we've raised $48M across four rounds and are growing quickly: We're live in over 500 stores across the USA, Canada, and the Caribbean, and integrated with over 20 industry partners. - Communicative: You can synthesize messy field research into something clear and defensible.

Our team provides the antenna pointing and tracking control systems for Viasat ground and airborne antenna systems. Our team is responsible for real-time positioner control, antenna controller embedded hardware/software, and pointing analysis. Our product provides tracking control for Viasat antennas big and small all over the globe.

- Automating tests to improve our software and hardware quality

Design Verification Engineer Intern

About the Team

The Design Verification team verifies the RDU, SambaNova's chip forAI workloads. We build SystemVerilog and UVM environments for chip-level control and initialization, including sequencing, state transitions, clocking, and recovery, and work with architects, RTL designers, and firmware engineers.

About the Role

As a Design Verification Engineer Intern, you'll write testbenches, tests, checkers, and coverage in SystemVerilog and UVM for RDU features. You'll run regressions, debug simulation failures, and work with RTL designers to find bugs before tape-out. A dedicated mentor will guide you throughout the internship.

Responsibilities

- Help write and execute verification plans for chip-level control and initialization features

- Build SystemVerilog and UVM testbench components, including sequences, checkers, assertions, and functional coverage

- Write directed and constrained-random tests to find corner cases

- Debug simulation and regression failures with RTL designers

- Analyze functional and code coverage and help close coverage gaps

- Present your project results to the team at the end of your internship

Required Qualifications

- Currently pursuing a B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field

- Coursework or project experience in digital design and computer architecture Experience with SystemVerilog or Verilog

- Scripting experience in Python, Perl, TCL, or shell

- Familiarity with UVM

- Familiarity with constrained-random verification, functional coverage, and assertions Familiarity with clock domain crossing concepts

Preferred Qualifications

- Pursuing an M.S. or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field

- Experience using AI tools such as Claude for verification development and debug Prior internship experience in design verification
